description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelConcat class, which extends SugarWidgetField and provides a method to concatenate and display specific fields from a layout definition in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelConcat
classes.description: A widget class for concatenating and rendering fields in a sub-panel layout for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Concatenates specified source fields from the layout definition and returns the combined string.
